material_slots_note: Skin and Outfit are baked BC/N/ORM sets; Hair is one alpha-tested atlas (hair, brows, lashes): base colour + alpha and a strand normal, no ORM (roughness 0.5 constant); Eyes is a base-colour iris map

status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: Built on the CC0 MakeHuman base mesh and its bundled skin, eye, brow, lash and hair assets, morphed here by simple region scaling: the face is the base face (no likeness work), and the hair is the bundled card cap, not groomed strands. Clothes are cut from the base mesh's garment helpers and loosened, with folds only in the normal map: no cloth simulation, so skirts follow the thighs through skin weights and will clip on long strides. Skeleton is the project humanoid core set (25 bones, no fingers or twist bones); weights are automatic (bone heat) and unreviewed in motion; no animation, Physics Asset or facial rig. Hands are open (the base A pose). Hair has no ORM map. Not imported into Unreal. The stoop is modelled into the rest pose (bent back), so standard humanoid clips will read slightly more upright at the hips than the mesh. The stick is rigid to the hand bone, not gripped.
